name: TokenStationDockDark
source_reference: The native 1024px icon_512x512@2x.png representation extracted from apps/desktop/src-tauri/icons/icon.icns
brief: Create the dark runtime Dock icon by inverting the current Token Station icon while preserving the orange route stripe exactly.

semantic_review.basis: The current shipped icon is transformed directly without redrawing its geometry.
semantic_review.notes: Raster is intentional because this is a color-only runtime variant of the shipped raster icon. The orange stripe and antialiased orange edge pixels remain unchanged.

source_analysis.fidelity_target: Preserve the exact current icon geometry and orange stripe while swapping the light and dark neutral colors.
must_preserve: the native transparent outer padding and rounded-corner alpha mask
the orange diagonal stripe and its antialiased edges
the existing spacing, crop, and proportions
must_not_add: blue dots, orange squares, alternate station marks, text, glow, or new geometry
acceptance_checks: orange pixels are byte-identical to the source
non-orange pixels are RGB inverses of the source

warnings: recommended package shape is 2-5 semantic layers, or at most 8 for an explicit bounded pane/sticker style
claims: spec-driven reusable cross-platform icon source package
unrounded app/source canvas outputs retained separately from preview masking
